messages:
anya: quick sync on the pool picker prototype i just uploaded: https://figma.com/file/newui

jess: main friction: long list hides common pools. propose a 3-item quick-strip (most used + pinned) at the top.

mike: backend can return preferredPools array, low risk. will add analytics events for quick picks.

jess: UI: selected pool chip should show a tiny SLO pill (text not just color) e.g., 'Low-latency'. keeps it human.

omar: a11y: pill needs aria-label and >=4.5:1 contrast. don't rely on color alone.

lee: copy: change 'Burst' label to 'Burst capacity (time-limited)' and add a tiny help link to billing. customers keep asking if it's extra charge.

khalid: slider keyboard fallback: arrow keys adjust, numeric stepper fallback, and announce via aria-live: 'Latency target: Balanced. Cost: Medium.' keep short (<60 chars).

anya: clamp behavior: if Min > poolMax show inline message and SR announcement: 'Min adjusted to pool max: 4.'

mike: note: pool caps are in a separate service; client should cache caps for ~2 minutes to avoid extra calls.

jess: will update frames with quick-strip, SLO pill text, burst microcopy, keyboard help text and post by tomorrow.

anya: thanks all \"
